{{Quote|The Victory Races of Naboo. Your skill they will test.|Yoda to a promising recruit|<ref name="YCAC" />}}
The '''Victory Races of Naboo''' was a friendly competition that was organized between the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] as a celebration for their victory over the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] armies. The two contestants were [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] herself and [[Bombad General/Legends|Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] had sent a [[Unidentified young new recruit|skillful Jedi youngling]] to help the contestants prepare for the race.<ref name="YCAC" />

The race extended on a great variety of terrains and landforms, going through forests, [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] in the vicinity of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Despite the racers using different steeds (Amidala rode a [[tusk cat]] and Binks a [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]]), this was a fair match. Indeed, the kaadu was better at interacting with swamps and [[Water/Legends|water]], while the tusk cat was good at climbing through mountains.<ref name="YCAC" />
